irāmāyaṇam vāṉmīkarāṟ ceyyappaṭṭatu. nāṭṭuppāṭalkaḷ pōlirunta paḻaiya pāṭalkaḷiliruntu irāmayaṇañ ceyyappaṭṭa teṉak karutappaṭukiṉṟatu. itu ki.mu. aintām allatu āṟām nūṟ ṟāṇṭil toṭaṅki kiṟittuvukkup piṉ cila nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷ varai vaḷarntu koṇṭu ceṉṟatu. toṭakkattil itu paḻaiya kataiyaik kūṟuvatāka iruntatu. piṉpu atu vaiṇava nūlāka māṟṟappaṭṭatu. cītāpirāṭṭiyiṉ tantaiyākiya caṉakaṉ yākñavalki kālattavarākak kūṟappaṭuvatālum, yākñavalki caṉamēcayaṉ kālattavarātalālum irāmāyaṇa nikaḻcci pārata nikaḻccikkup piṟpaṭṭateṉak karutap paṭukiṉṟatu. pārata nikaḻccikaḷaippaṟṟiyō irāmāyaṇa nikaḻcciyaip paṟṟiyō vētaṅkaḷ kūṟavillai. vētakāla makkaḷ uḻavu cālaic cītai eṉṉum peyarāl vaḻipaṭṭārkaḷ.
irāmāyaṇam āriyak koḷkaikaḷ teṉṉāṭṭiṟ parappap paṭṭa varalāṟṟaik kūṟukiṟateṉac cilar kūṟukiṉṟaṉar. irāmāyaṇap pōr teṉṉāṭṭiṉarukkum irāvaṇaṉukkum nērnta pōrākak kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. irāmar irāvaṇaṉaik koṉṟu cītaiyaic ciṟai mīṭṭukkoṇṭu uṭaṉē tirumpi viṭṭār. avar vaḻiyil civaliṅkam vaittup pūcitta talam irāmēcuvaram eṉappaṭukiṟatu. irāmarāl nēr niṉṟu pōril vellutaṟkariyaṉāyirunta vāli pūcitta talam kuraṅkāṭu tuṟai. irāvaṇaṉ civaliṅka pūcai ceyyum civa pattaṉāka iruntāṉ.
irāmāyaṇattiṟ kūṟappaṭum camayam civaliṅka vaḻipāṭāka iruntatu. intiraṉ teyvaṅkaḷukkut talaivaṉāka iruntāṉ. kāmaṉ, kupēraṉ, kārttikēyaṉ, viṭṭuṇu, civaṉ, ilakkumi, umai mutaliya teyvaṅkaḷum, teyvaṅkaḷākkappaṭṭa cēṭaṉ, caṭāyu, nanti mutaliya vum kūṟappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. vaḻipāṭu vēḷvi muṟaiyāka iruntatu. viṭṭuṇu vum civaṉum talai iṭam peṟukiṉṟaṉar. civaṉ kāmaṉai erittatu, pakīrataṉ kaṅkaiyaip pūmikkuk koṇṭu vantatu, pāṟkaṭalileḻunta nañcaic civaṉuṇṭatu, tēvācurar pāṟkaṭalaik kaṭaintatu, civaṉ tiripuraṅ kaḷai erittatu mutaliya kataikaḷ irāmāyaṇattiṟ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. irāmar avatāramākak kūṟappaṭavillai. vaṭa nāṭṭukkatai oṉṟaiyum teṉṉāṭṭukkatai oṉṟaiyum iṇaittuc ceyyappaṭṭatu irāmā yaṇam eṉṉum karuttum iruntu varukiṉṟatu.27
purāṇaṅkaḷ
itikācaṅkaḷ tōṉṟiyapiṉ purāṇaṅkaḷ tōṉṟiṉa. ivai ki.mu. aintām nūṟṟāṇṭil tōṉṟiṉa. apattamparum (ki.mu.400) kauṭaliyarum purāṇaṅkaḷaip paṟṟik kuṟippiṭukiṉṟaṉar. ākavē ak kālattil purāṇaṅkaḷ iruntaṉaveṉpatu terikiṟatu. intiya nāṭṭiṉ palvēṟu pakutikaḷil kōyil purōkitarkaḷāl eḻutivaikkappaṭṭa varalāṟukaḷum cevi vaḻakkil vanta paḻaṅkataikaḷum tiraṭṭappaṭṭup purāṇaṅkaḷ ceyyappaṭṭaṉa. ivai pala kālaṅkaḷil kūṭṭiyum, kuṟaittum, māṟṟiyum eḻutappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.28 patiṉeṭṭup purāṇaṅ kaḷum, patiṉeṭṭu upapurāṇaṅkaḷumuḷḷaṉa. pākavatam, nāratīyam, karuṭam, patumam, varākam eṉpavai viṭṭuṇu purāṇaṅkaḷ. civa, iliṅka, iskanta, akkiṉi, maṟca, kūrma eṉpaṉa civa purāṇaṅkaḷ; pirama, piramāṇṭa, vaivartta, mārkkaṇṭēya, vāmaṉa, pāvicsyā eṉpaṉa pirama purāṇaṅkaḷ. ivaṟṟuḷ pala pattu allatu paṉṉiraṇṭu nūṟ ṟāṇṭukaḷukku muṉ ceyyappaṭṭaṉavākak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. purā ṇaṅkaḷ pirapañcap paṭaippu, calappiraḷayam, maṉuvantaram, maṉukkaḷ, tēvarkaḷiṉ piṟappu, avarkaḷiṉ varalāṟu mutaliyavaṟṟaik kūṟukiṉ ṟaṉa. purāṇaṅkaḷaic ceytavar viyācar eṉṉum aitīkam vaḻaṅkukiṉṟatu. purāṇa kālattil piramā, viṣṇu, civaṉ eṉṉum kaṭavuḷar mummūrtti kaḷākkappaṭṭaṉar. vaḻipāṭu kōyil vaḻipāṭāka iruntatu.*
nātaṉāraruḷ peṟu nanti tantiṭak
kōtilā tuṇar caṉaṟ kumaraṉ kūṟiṭa
vātarāyaṇa muṉi vakuppa vōrntuṇar
cūtaṉōtiyatu mūvāṟu tolkatai (kanta purāṇam)
#“makāpāratap pōrukkuppiṉ āṅkāṅku nāṭṭuk kataikaḷāka vaḻaṅkiyavai ellām tiraṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. attiraṭṭu, purāṇa caṅkitai eṉṉum peyar peṟṟiruntatu. purāṇacaṅkitaiyai ātāramākak koṇṭu pala purāṇaṅkaḷ eḻuntaṉa. kālantōṟum ivaṟṟuḷ piṉ cērppukaḷākap pala eḻutip pukuttappaṭṭaṉa. piramāṇṭa, vāyu, maṟca eṉpavai kālattāl muṟpaṭṭavai; pirama vaivartta, civa, vāmaṉa, pākavatam eṉpavai mikap piṟkālattavai; maṟṟavai iṭaikkālattavai. ivaṟṟuḷ paḻaiyavai mārk kaṇṭēyamum piramamum. pirama purāṇat tiṉ pakuti paḻaiyatu aṉṟāyiṉum atu āti purāṇameṉappaṭṭatu. patmapurāṇam maṟcapurāṇattukku uṟavuṭaiyatākak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu. ataṉ perum pakuti piṟkālattatu. atil pañcatantirakkatai, itōpa tēcakkatai pōṉṟa nītik kataikaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. purāṇaṅ kaḷāvaṉa : pirama, patma, viṭṭuṇu, civa, pākavata, nāratīya, mārkkaṇṭēya, akkiṉi, pāviciya, piramavaivartta, iliṅka, varāka, iskanta, vāmaṉa, kūrma, maṟca, karuṭa, pirāmaṇṭa. ivvaricaiyil pukaḻpeṟṟa vāyu purāṇaṅ kāṇappaṭavillai. toṭakkattil vāyupurāṇamum piramāṇ ṭamum oṉṟāka iruntaṉa. ivviru purāṇaṅkaḷum collukkuc col ottirukkiṉṟaṉa. vāyupurāṇam kūrmapurāṇam ivviraṇṭaiyum oṉṟākak koṇṭu vāyāviya piramāṇṭa eṉak kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.”
“patiṉeṭṭup purāṇaṅkaḷait tavirap patiṉeṭṭu upa purāṇaṅ kaḷumuṇṭu. ivai muṉivarkaḷāṟ ceyyappaṭṭavai eṉak kūrmapurā ṇamuṅ karuṭapurāṇamuṅ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟukku mikka paḻamaiyaik koṭuppataṟkāka avai maṉuvāl ceyyappaṭṭavai eṉṟu patmapurā ṇam kūṟukiṉṟatu. upa purāṇaṅkaḷāvaṉa : caṉaṟkumāra, naracimma, skanta, civatarma, turvāca, mārkkaṇṭēya, kapila, vāmaṉa, ucāṉa, piramāṇṭa, varuṇa, kāḷikā, makēcuvara, cāmpa, caura, paracurāma, mārīca, pārkkava eṉpaṉa.”
taruma cāttiraṅkaḷ
29vētaṅkaḷil collappaṭum tarumaṅkaḷai allatu oḻukkaṅ kaḷait tiraṭṭik kūṟum nūlkaḷ* taruma cāttiraṅkaḷ eṉappaṭṭaṉa. ācuvalāyaṉam, pōtāyaṉam, apastampam mutaliyaṉa cūttira vaṭivil ceyyappaṭṭa paḻaiya nūlkaḷ. taruma cūttiraṅkaḷait toṭarntu mikuti nūlkaḷ tōṉṟiṉa. maṉu mirutiyum yākñavalkiya mirutiyum mirutikaḷil mutaṉmaiyuṭaiyavai. taruma cāttiraṅkaḷ patiṉeṭṭu eṉappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. maṉu, yākñavalkiyam, nāratīyam, parācaram, pirakaspati mutaliyavum piṟavumākiya mirutikaḷ mikap paḻaṅkālattil vāḻnta iruṭikaḷiṉ peyarkaḷaip peṟṟiruppiṉum avai kiṟittuvukkup pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷiṉ piṉ ceyyappaṭṭaṉavākak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.# vicayanakara aracar kālattil vittiyāraṇiyar parācara mirutikku virivurai ceytār. ammiruti nūlai ātāramākak koṇṭu vicayanakara aracariṉ caṭṭaṅkaḷ ceyyappaṭṭaṉa. kiḻakkintiyak kampeṉiyār kālattil ceyyappaṭṭa intuc caṭṭam (intu lā) eṉpatu mīmāmcai nūlaiyum miruti nūlkaḷaiyum ātāramākak koṇṭu pirāmaṇarāṟ ceyyap paṭṭatu.
cūttira vaṭivil ceyyappaṭṭa taruma nūlkaḷ kautamam, pōtāyaṉam, āpastampam, vaciṭṭam, viṣṇu eṉpaṉa. miruti nūlkaḷ piṉvaruvaṉa : maṉu, attiri, viṣṇu, hāritar, *yākñavalkiyar, ucaṉar, āṅkīracar, yamar, āpastampar, camvarttar, kāttiyāyaṉar , pirakaspati, parācarar, viyācar, caṅkar, vikitar, takkar, kautamar, cātātapar, vaciṭṭar mutaliyavarkaḷiṉ peyar peṟṟavai.
vaitīkattil varuṇamum varuṇāccirama tarumaṅkaḷum mukkiya muṭaiyaṉa. pirāmaṇa, cattiriya, vaiciya, cūttira eṉṉum nāṉku varuṇaṅ kaḷum piṟappiṉāl uṇṭāṉavai. ivarkaḷukkuḷḷa nītikaḷum vev vēṟāṉavai. tamiḻnāṭṭu nīti avvāṟirukkavillai. piṟappiṉāl ellārum oru kulattiṉar; ceyyum toḻil vēṟṟumaiyāl avarkaḷ vevvēṟu kulattiṉar. āyiṉum “piṟappokku mellāvuyirkkuñ ciṟappovvā - ceytoḻil vēṟṟumaiyāl” (tirukkuṟaḷ) “oṉṟē kulamum oruvaṉē tēvaṉum naṉṟē niṉaimiṉ” (tirumantiram) eṉkiṉ ṟaṉa tamiḻ maṟaikaḷ. vaṭanāṭṭu nītikkum teṉṉāṭṭu nītikkumuḷḷa vēṟupāṭṭai, “vaḷḷuvar cey tirukkuṟaḷai vaḻuvaṟa naṉkuṇarn tōrkaḷ - uḷḷuvarō maṉuvāti oru kulattukkoru nīti” eṉṉum maṉōṉmaṇīyac ceyyuḷ iṉitu viḷakkukiṉṟatu.
teṉṉāṭṭil vaitīkam
vaṭanāṭṭil āriyar tamiḻar eṉṉum iru iṉattiṉarum kalantu oṉṟupaṭṭaṉar. vaitīkamum uḷnāṭṭu matamum kalappaṭaintaṉa. pirāmaṇa matattiṉar, tām putitākac ceṉṟu vāḻa nērnta iṭaṅkaḷuk kēṟpa am makkaḷiṉ oḻukkaṅkaḷaiyum teyvaṅkaḷaiyum tammavai pōlat taḻuvik koṇṭārkaḷ. vēta matattaiyum vēḷvikaḷaiyum etirkkum pautta matattait tōṟṟuvitta kautama puttaraiyē avarkaḷ viṭṭuṇuviṉ avatāramākkit tamatu kaṭavuḷaruḷ cērttuk koṇṭārkaḷ.#
pattirapāku eṉṉum camaṇa muṉivariṉ talaimaiyil mauriya cantirakuptaṉum pala camaṇa muṉivarkaḷum maicūriluḷḷa pelakoḷa eṉṉumiṭattukkuc ceṉṟu taṅkiṉārkaḷeṉat teṉṉintiya camaṇar kaḷiṉ varalāṟu kūṟukiṉṟatu. ivarkaḷai aṭuttup pirāmaṇarkaḷum pauttarum teṟkē vantirukkalām.31 pirāmaṇar tamatu matattaip parappum nōkkamākavō, atikārattai nāṭṭavirumpiyō iṅku varavillai. tolkāppiyam ceyyappaṭukiṉṟa kālattil ivarkaḷ tamiḻnāṭṭil iruntārkaḷ. vaṭanāṭṭup pirāmaṇar vaḻakkukaḷ cilavaṟṟōṭu tamiḻ vaḻakkukaḷ oppiṭṭuk kūṟappaṭṭirukkiṉṟaṉa. caṅka kālattil aṅkumiṅkum cila vaitīka matattiṉar vāḻntu koṇṭirun tārkaḷ. avarkaḷ tamiḻar camayak koḷkaikaḷil māṟṟattaic ceyyakkūṭiya avvaḷavu peruntokaiyiṉarāka irukkavillai.32
yākaṅkaḷ ceyvatāl pakaivaraip pōril vellalām, celvam atikarikkum, āyuḷ perukum eṉṉum nampikkaikaḷ iruntaṉa. tamiḻ aracaruṭ cilar in nampikkaikaḷil tōyntu pirāmaṇap purōkitar vāyilāka yākaṅkaḷ ceytaṉar.33 itu caṅka kāla aracarkaḷ cilarukku “irācacūyam vēṭṭaṭa”, “palyāka cālai” mutaliya aṭai moḻikaḷ vaḻaṅkiyamai koṇṭu aṟiya varukiṉṟatu.
āṅkilattil varalāṟu eḻutiyavarkaḷ tamiḻil antaṇar eṉṉum coṟ kāṇappaṭṭāl atai pirāmaṇar eṉṟu moḻipeyarttiruk kiṟārkaḷ. maṟṟaiya nāṭukaḷil pōlavē tamiḻ nāṭṭil camaya karumaṅkaḷaik kaṇkāṇikkum kurumār iruntārkaḷ. ivarkaḷ antaṇar eṉavum, pārppaṉareṉavum, purōkitar eṉavum aṟiyappaṭṭārkaḷ. ippeyarkaḷai ellām pirāmaṇaṉ eṉṟu moḻipeyarttatiṉāl tamiḻ nāṭṭil camayamirukkavillai, kurumārirukkavillai, kurumār vaṭanāṭṭiṉiṉṟum vantaṉar; camayamum vaṭanāṭṭiṉiṉṟu vantatu eṉṟum tavaṟāṉa koḷkaikaḷ eḻukiṉṟaṉa.
vaṭa nāṭṭār paṭaiyeṭuppu 
muṟkālattil tamiḻ nāṭṭukku vaṭakkē taṇṭakam eṉṉum peruṅkāṭu iruntatu. atu ippōtaiya orissā, āntirap piratēcam, mattiyap piratēcam eṉpavaṟṟai aṭakkiya parappāka iruntatu. tamiḻ nāṭṭil vāḻntu koṇṭirunta makkaḷē vaṭakku nōkkic ceṉṟu vintiya malaittoṭar varaiyil kuṭiyēṟiṉārkaḷ. vintiyattukkut teṟkil vāḻnta ellā makkaḷum toṭakkattil orē moḻiyum paṇpāṭum uṭaiyavarkaḷāka iruntārkaḷ. vaitīka matam vaṭanāṭṭi ṉiṉṟum teṟku nōkki vantu koṇṭiruntatu. vaitīkariṉ moḻi camakkirutamāka iruntatu. pautta camaṇa mataṅkaḷum teṟku nōkki vantaṉa. immataṅkaḷiṉ moḻikaḷ, pirākirutaṅkaḷum camakkirutamumāka iruntaṉa. pirākirutaṅkaḷum camakkirutamum teṟkē vāḻnta makkaḷiṉ moḻiyōṭu kalantaṉa. ataṉāl kaṉṉaṭam, teluṅku, tuḷu, malai yāḷam mutaliya moḻikaḷ tōṉṟiṉa.
kaliṅkam āntiram mutaliya nāṭukaḷ nantar mauriyar mutaliya vaṭa nāṭṭār āḷukaikkuṭpaṭṭiruntaṉa. mauriya āṭci vīḻntapiṉ cātavākaṉar eṉṉum aracar āntira nāṭṭai āṇṭaṉar. mauriyar āṭciyil atikārikaḷāka iruntavarkaḷ avvāṭci oḻintapiṉ kaṭṭuppāṭaṟṟa ciṟṟaracarkaḷāyiṉar. ivarkaḷ pirāmaṇarākavum vaitīka matattilum camakkirutattilum paṟṟuṭaiyavarkaḷākavumiruntārkaḷ. acuvamētam mutaliya vēḷvikaḷaic ceytu vantārkaḷ.34 tamiḻ nāṭṭiṉiṉṟum ceṉṟu vaṭakkē kuṭiyēṟiya āriyamayamāṉavarkaḷē āntirar eṉa varalāṟṟāciriyarkaḷ kūṟiyirukkiṉṟārkaḷ. ciṟī cātakarṇi eṉṉum cātavākaṉa aracaṉ (ki.mu.189) periya yākaṅkaḷaic ceytā ṉeṉṟum yākattiṟ purōkitarāka irunta pirāmaṇarukkup pattāyirak kaṇakkāṉa pacukkaḷaiyum , āyirakkaṇakkāṉa kutiraikaḷaiyum, anēkam yāṉaikaḷaiyum pala kirāmaṅkaḷaiyum, pattāyirakkaṇakkāṉa kārcap paṇattaiyum tāṉamākak koṭuttāṉeṉṟum oru cācaṉam kūṟukiṉṟatu. ivvāṟu āntira nāṭu vaitīkamayamāka iruntatu.
cātavākaṉar vīḻcci aṭainta pōtu avarkaḷiṉ kīḻ atikāri kaḷāka iruntōr kaṭṭuppāṭaṟṟa ciṟṟaracarkaḷāka māṟiṉar. ivarkaḷil cilar ki.pi. āṟām nūṟṟāṇṭil tamiḻnāṭṭiṉmītu paṭai eṭut tārkaḷ. ivarkaḷ cōḻa nāṭṭiṉ oru pakutiyākiya toṇṭai nāṭṭaiveṉṟu kāñcīpurattait talainakarākak koṇṭu pattām nūṟṟāṇṭuvarai āṭci purintārkaḷ. ivarkaḷ pallavar eṉa aṟiyap paṭṭārkaḷ. ivarkaḷ tamiḻaṟiyātavar; vaitīka matattiṉar; camakkirutak kalvikkup pērātaravu aḷittavar.35 pallavarkālac cācaṉamoṉṟu iskantavarmaṉ pārattuvāca kōttirattavaṉ eṉak kūṟukiṉṟatu. pallavarait toṭarntu vaṭakkil niṉṟum teṟkē paṭai eṭuttu vantavarkaḷ irāṭṭira kūṭar, katampar, kaṅkar, hōycalar, cāḷukkiyar, kākatīyar eṉap palarāvar. ivarkaḷil pauttam allatu camaṇattait taḻuvāta aracar vaitīkarākavum vaṭamoḻip paṟṟuṭaiyarāy ataṉai ātarippōrākavum iruntaṉar. kaṭampa aracar pirāmaṇa vamicattavarāka iruntaṉar.36 mayūravarmaṉ eṉṉum katampa aracaṉ (ki.pi.345-360) patiṉeṭṭu acuvamētayākaṅkaḷ purintu pala kirāmaṅkaḷaip pirāmaṇa rukkut tāṉam vaḻaṅkiyataip paṟṟic cācaṉam oṉṟu kūṟukiṟatu.
vicayanakara aracāṅkam vaitīkamayamāka iruntatu. vittiyaraṇiyar parācaramirutikku urai eḻutiṉār. avar uraiyaiyum, mirutiyaiyum taḻuvi aracāṅkac caṭṭaṅkaḷ ceyyappaṭṭaṉa. camakkirutak kalviyai vaḷarp pataṟku perumuyaṟci ceyyappaṭṭatu.* piṟkālattil āriyak koḷkai kaḷait taḻuviya teṉṉāṭṭaracar tammaic cattiriyar eṉak kūṟik koṇṭu pūṇūl tarittaṉar# paṇṭait tamiḻaracar ivvāṟu ceytu koḷḷavillai.
kōyilkaḷ
vaitīkariṉ vaḻipāṭu yāka muṟaiyākavum, teṉṉāṭṭiṉar vaḻipāṭu kōyil muṟaiyākavum iruntaṉa. vētaṅkaḷil kōyilamait tal, kōyil kiriyaikaḷ ceytal, tiruvainteḻuttu ōtutal, tirunīṟu pūcutal pōṉṟavaṟṟukku vitikaḷum viḷakkaṅkaḷum kiṭaiyā. kōyil vaḻipāṭu, viḻākkaḷ avaṟṟiṉ viḷakkaṅkaḷ pōlvaṉa ākamaṅkaḷil kūṟappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. kōyil kiriyaikaḷ cila karuttukkaḷai viḷakkum apinayaṅkaḷ eṉa aṟiñar kūṟukiṉṟaṉar. itu kāraṇamākavē tēvatāci vaḻakkam kōyilkaḷil iruntu vantatu. muṟkālattil kallāleṭuk kappaṭṭa kōyilkaḷ nakaraṅkaḷilēyē iruntaṉa. ēṉaiya iṭaṅkaḷil niḻal maraṅkaḷiṉ kīḻ civaliṅkaṅkaḷ vaittu vaḻipaṭappaṭṭaṉa. piṟ kālattil avvaruṭ kuṟikaḷaic cuṟṟik kaṭṭaṭamamaikkappaṭṭatu. kuttā lattil ālum palāvum, tirunelvēliyil mūṅkilum, maturaiyil kaṭampum, tiruvāṉaikkāvil nāvalum, citamparattil tillaiyum, tiruvoṟṟiyūril makiḻamum talamaraṅkaḷāka iruttal itaṟkuc cāṉ ṟākum. ellā makkaḷum uyarvu tāḻvu eṉṉum vēṟupāṭiṉṟi aruḷ taṟikaḷai vaḻipaṭṭārkaḷ. aruṭkuṟiyaiyum ataṉaic cūḻnta iṭat taiyum mēṟpārttuk kaṭavuḷai arccittavarkaḷ pārppār eṉap paṭṭaṉar. pārppār eṉpataṟku mēṟpārppavar eṉpatu poruḷ.
vaṭanāṭṭiṉiṉṟum vanta pallavar hōycaḷar, kaṅkar, cāḷuk kiyar, irāṭṭira kūṭar mutaliya aracar vaitīka camayattavarkaḷāka irun tārkaḷ; civaṉ tirumāl mutaliya kaṭavuḷaraiyum vaḻipaṭṭārkaḷ. kōyil kaḷil vēḷāṇ marapaic cērnta tēcikar pōṉṟavarkaḷ arccakarāka iruntu vantārkaḷ. avarkaḷ tamiḻil tutipāṭik kaṭavuḷaip pūcit tārkaḷ. kōyil vaḻipāṭukaḷaik kūṟum ākamaṅkaḷ tamiḻilēyē iruntaṉa.
“muttiyai ñāṉattai muttamiḻ ōcaiyai”
“tamiḻmaṇ ṭalamaintun tāviya ñāṉa
mumiḻvatu pōla vulakan tirivar
aviḻu maṉamumem māti yaṟivum
tamiḻmaṇ ṭalamaintun tattuvamāmē”
“catācivan tattuva muttamiḻ vētam”
“centami ḻāti teḷintu vaḻipaṭu
nantiyitaṉai navamuraittāṉē”
“īṟāṉa kaṉṉi kumariyē kāviri
vēṟā navatīrtta mikkuḷḷa veṟpēḻuḷ
pēṟāṉa vētākamamē piṟatta lāṉ
māṟāta teṉṟicai vaiyakañ cuttamē”
eṉavarum tirumantirac ceyyuṭkaḷ caivacittānta ñāṉamum ākamaṅ kaḷum tamiḻiliruntaṉa eṉpatait terivikkiṉṟaṉa. vaitīka camayattai mēlākak koṇṭa aracar pārppārai vilakkip pirāmaṇarai arccaka rāka amarttiṉar. avarkaḷ tamiḻaṟiyātavarum kōyil kiriyaikaḷai aṟiyātavarumāka iruntārkaḷ. ākavē kōyil vaḻipāṭṭukku viḷakkam kūṟum ākamaṅkaḷ vaṭamoḻippaṭuttappaṭṭaṉa.* ippoḻutu vaṭa moḻiyil kāṇappaṭum ākamaṅkaḷ eḻutappaṭṭuḷḷa camakkiruta naṭai ki.pi. 10ām nūṟṟāṇṭaic cērntateṉa ārāycci aṟiñar kūṟukiṉ ṟaṉar. vaṭa moḻippaṭuttappaṭṭa ākamaṅkaḷiṉiṭaiyiṭaiyē vaitīkak karuttukkaḷum pukuttappaṭṭaṉa. vaṭamoḻippaṭuttappaṭṭapiṉ tamiḻ nūlkaḷ aḻikkappaṭṭaṉa. tillaiyil tēvāraṅkaḷ pūṭṭivaikkappaṭ ṭirunta varalāṟu ivvakai muyaṟcikaḷiloṉṟākum. puttakōcar eṉpār ciṅkaḷa moḻiyilirunta pautta nūlkaḷaip pāḷiyil moḻi peyarttapiṉ ciṅkaḷa nūlkaḷai ellām tiraṭṭi erittuviṭṭāreṉa varalāṟṟāciriyarkaḷ kūṟiyirukkiṉṟaṉar. itu pōṉṟa katiyē tamiḻuk kum nērntatu.#
caivattukku māṟupaṭṭa vaitīkar kōyil pūcakarāka amarn tatait tamiḻaṟiñar virumpavillai.
“pērkoṇṭa pārppāṉ pirāṉṟaṉṉai yarccittāl
pōrkoṇṭa vēntarkkup pollā viyātiyām
pārkoṇṭa nāṭṭukkup pañcamu māmeṉṟē
cīrkoṇṭa nanti terintu raittāṉē.”
“cattiya miṉṟit taṉiñāṉan tāṉiṉṟi
otta viṭayam viṭṭōru muṇarviṉṟi
pattiyumiṉṟip paraṉuṇmai yiṉṟiyūṇ
pittēṟu mūṭar pirāmaṇar tāmaṉṟē.”
“nūluñ cikaiyum nuvaliṟ piramamō
nūlatu kāṟpāca nuṇcikai kēcamā
nūlatu vētānta nuṇcikai ñāṉamā
nūliṭai yantaṇar kāṇa nuvaliṉē.”
eṉṉum tirumantirac ceyyuṭkaḷ vaitīkap pirāmaṇarai nōkkik kūṟap paṭṭavai eṉa aṟiñar karutukiṉṟaṉar.
aruḷtaṟikaḷ allatu civaliṅkaṅkaḷaic cuṟṟik kōyilkaḷ eḻuntaṉa. tamiḻ nāṭṭiṟ pirāmaṇar palar irukkavillai. ik kōyil kaḷil pūcakarāka amarttuvataṟku aracar vaṭanāṭṭiṉiṉṟum mūvāyira var nālāyiravar eṉap pirāmaṇak kuṭumpaṅkaḷaik koṇṭu van tārkaḷ. avarkaḷaik kōyilaic cūḻavum kirāmaṅkaḷilum kuṭiyēṟ ṟiṉārkaḷ.* avarkaḷukku nilaṅkaḷum vīṭukaḷum māṉiyamāka aḷikkap paṭṭaṉa. avarkaḷukku ellā varikaḷum nīkkappaṭṭiruntaṉa.
pōtiya pirāmaṇar teṉṉāṭṭilillāmaiyāl pirāmaṇa rallātārum pirāmaṇarākkappaṭṭārkaḷ. pirāmaṇa vakuppiṉar tamiḻ nāṭṭuk kurukkaḷ kuṭumpaṅkaḷilum tirumaṇañ ceytu koṇṭārkaḷ.
caiva vaitīka mataṅkaḷiṉ kalappu
tamiḻar camayattaik kuṟittu cēṣa aiyaṅkāravarkaḷ tirāviṭa intiyā eṉṉum tamatu nūliṟ kūṟiyiruppataṉ curukkam varumāṟu: tamiḻarkaḷiṭaiyē aḻakuk kalaikaḷum camayamum vaḷarcciyaṭaintirun taṉa. “teṉṉintiyāvil tattuvañāṉa nūlkaḷ irukkiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟil vaṭanāṭṭuc celvākku ōraḷavu kāṇappaṭṭālum nāṭṭukkuc contamāṉa tattuvañāṉam kāṇappaṭukiṉ ṟatu. varalāṟu campantamāṉa ārāyccikku avai peritum payaṉpaṭattakkaṉa” eṉṟu māksmūlar āṟu tattuvañāṉaṅkaḷ eṉṉum nūlil kūṟiyuḷḷār. teṉṉintiya camayam taṉippaṭṭa toṭakkamuṭaiyatu; piṟkālattil atu āriyac celvākkup peṟṟatu. tamiḻariṉ camayam cila vakaikaḷil āriyac celvākkukku uṭpaṭavillai eṉṟum, atu āriyar camayattiṉ mītu celvākku naṭattiyateṉṟum kāṭṭa muṭiyum. vētak koḷkaikaḷaiyum, vētak kiriyaikaḷaiyum ellārum ēṟṟuk koḷḷavillai. avaikaḷiṉ mutaṉmaiyaik kaṅkai yamuṉai āṟukaḷ pāyum palam poruntiya avarkaḷ nāṭukaḷilum pauttamum camaṇamum aṟaikūvi etirttaṉa. uyarnta cātiyiṉar eṉappaṭṭa ciṟupāṉmaiyiṉarē vētak koḷkai kaḷaip piṉpaṟṟiṉar; perumpālōr paḻaiya uḷnāṭṭu matak koḷkaikaḷaip piṉpaṟṟiṉārkaḷ.
vētakālat teyvaṅkaḷiṉ peyar mūlaṅkaḷ teḷivākak kāṇap paṭavillai. appeyar mūlaṅkaḷ intu airōppiya moḻikaḷil kāṇappaṭavillai. ākavē at teyvaṅkaḷ tamiḻariṉ teyvaṅka ḷātal vēṇṭum. āriyar vaḻippaṭṭa varuṇaṉ tamiḻar teyvamātal vēṇṭum. kaṭaṟkaraikaḷil vāḻnta makkaḷ vaḻipaṭṭa it teyvattai āriya iruṭikaḷ tamatu teyvaṅkaḷuḷ cērttu vaḻipaṭṭārkaḷ. āriyariṉ uruttiraṉ tamiḻar vaḻipaṭṭa iṉṉoru teyvam. uruttiraṉ eṉpatu civantavaṉ (civaṉ) eṉṉum tamiḻp peyariṉ moḻi peyarppu. veṟṟiyaik koṭukkum koṟṟavai tamiḻar teyvam. āriyariṉ tuvaṭṭā eṉṉum teyvam tamiḻk kammiyariṉ teyvamākalām. tamiḻ uḻavariṉ teyvam intira vaṇakkattuḷ maṟaintu viṭṭatu. civa, muruka vaṇakkaṅkaḷ āriyariṉ varukaikku muṉ intiya nāṭṭil iruntaṉa. intu matattiluḷḷa civaṉ, kiruṭṭiṇaṉ, irāmar, turkkai mutaliya teyvaṅkaḷum, teyvaṅkaḷiṉ avatāraṅkaḷum, maṟu piṟappuk koḷkai kaḷum vētaṅkaḷ aṟiyātavai. vēta matattil kāṇappaṭum ivai allāta piṟa pōkkukaḷ pāracīkam, kirīs mutaliya nāṭukaḷil kāṇap paṭuvaṉa pōṉṟavai.
paḻantamiḻariṉ camayam civa vaḻipāṭāka iruntateṉap pōppaiyar pōṉṟa aṟiñar karutiṉar. civaṉ arūpamāṉa tiyāṉa vaṭivilum, iliṅka vaṭivilum vaḻipaṭappaṭṭār eṉṟu ṭākṭar isṭipiṉcaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷār. *pūvum pukaiyum koṇṭu vaḻipaṭutal paḻaiya tamiḻariṉ vaḻipāṭṭu muṟai. pū itayattaiyum pukai aḵtu urukuvataiyum kuṟip piṭukiṉṟaṉa. irāvaṇaṉ poṉ# iliṅkattait taṉṉuṭaṉ koṇṭu ceṉṟu pūvum pukaiyum koṇṭu vaḻipaṭṭāṉ. irāvaṇaṉum vāli yum periya civapaktarkaḷ. vāli pūcitta talam kuraṅkāṭu tuṟai eṉṉum civattalam eṉappaṭukiṟatu. imayam mutal kumari varaiyil kōyilkaḷil civaliṅkaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. māpāratam civaliṅka vaṇakkattaip paṟṟik kūṟukiṉṟatu. acuvattāmāvai aruccuṉaṉ vellum valimaiyaip peṟṟu avaṉ civaṉai iliṅka vaṭivil vaḻipaṭṭateṉa viyācar kūṟiyirukkiṉṟār. acuvattāmā kaṭavuḷai maṉita vaṭivil vaḻipaṭṭār.
vētaṅkaḷum upaniṭataṅkaḷum iliṅka vaṇakkattaip paṟṟik kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. putiya kaṟkālak kuṭiyiruppukaḷil iliṅkaṅkaḷ kāṇap paṭṭaṉa. civaṉai iliṅka vaṭivil vaḻipaṭutal kaṟkālattilirunta teṉpatu itaṉāl terikiṟatu.
ki.pi. ēḻām nūṟṟāṇṭukku muṟpaṭṭa tamiḻ ilakkiya nūlkaḷil civaṉ eṉṉum col kāṇappaṭavillai eṉa iramaṇa cāttiri kūṟiyuḷ ḷār. 36civaṉ eṉṉum peyar vaḻakkiliruntatu. akattiyar civaṉiṭattil tamiḻaik kaṟṟār. itaṉāl civaṉ tamiḻar kaṭavuḷeṉat terikiṟatu. irukku vētam iliṅka vaṇakkattaik kaṇṭikkiṟatu. itaṉāl civa vaṇakkam vēta kālattukku muṉ iruntateṉat terikiṟatu. tamiḻariṉ kaṭavuḷar malai mukaṭukaḷiluṟaipavar. tamiḻar kaṭavuḷ malai aracaṉ. piṟkālattil civaṉ teṉ mukakkaṭavuḷ (takkaṇāmūrtti) eṉappaṭṭār.
ākamaṅkaḷ tamiḻt toṭakka muṭaiyaṉa. avai caiva cittānta ñāṉattukku ātāramākavuḷḷaṉa; avai tamiḻariṉ mutirnta aṟiviṟ piṟantavai. avai makēntira malaiyiliruntu civaṉāl veḷiyiṭap paṭṭavai. makēntiram tirunelvēlikkum tiruvitāṅkūrukkum iṭai yiluḷḷa potiya malaiyiṉ oru cikaram. tiruvācakam civaperumāṉai “mantira māmalai makēntira veṟpaṉ” “teṉ pāṇṭi nāṭṭāṉ” eṉak kūṟukiṉṟatu. civaṉ talaic caṅkamirunta pulavarkaḷuḷ oruvar. iṟai vaṉaik kuṟikkum paḻaiya col kaṭavuḷ. uḷḷattaik kaṭantavaṉ eṉpatu itaṉ poruḷ. potu makkaḷiṭaiyē muḻumutal vaṇakkat tōṭu ciṟu teyva vaṇakkamum pāmpu vaṇakkamum iruntaṉa. iṉṟum aṟivu mayamāṉa tattuva ñāṉaṅkaḷōṭu mūṭa nampikkaikaḷumiruntu varukiṉṟaṉa.
āriyar iṭi, kāṟṟup pōṉṟa iyaṟkaip poruḷkaḷaiyum iyaṟkai nikaḻccikaḷaiyum teyvaṅkaḷeṉak koṇṭu avaṟṟukkup paliyiṭṭu vaḻipaṭṭārkaḷ. ivvaḻipāṭu tamiḻarukkut teyva nintai pōlaviruntatu. āriyariṉ teyvaṅkaḷ tāḻntaṉavākak koḷḷap paṭṭaṉa. avai poruṭṭuc ceyyappaṭṭa vēḷvikaḷ taṭukkappaṭṭaṉa.
mikap paḻaiya kālattil tamiḻar tattuvañāṉamuṭaiyavarkaḷāka iruntaṉar. irukku vētakāla āriyar maṟupiṟappuk koḷkaiyai aṟintirukkavillai. avarkaḷ ik koḷkaiyait tamiḻariṭamiruntu aṟintārkaḷ.
tamiḻariṭaiyē mutaṉ mutal koṇṭu varappaṭṭa ayalnāṭṭa var celvākku vētamatamākum. oṉṟōṭu oṉṟu campantappaṭāta camayaṅkaḷum nākarikaṅkaḷum oṉṟupaṭumpōtu eṉṉa nikaḻkiṟatu? conta vaḻipāṭum tattuva ñāṉamuṭaiyavarkaḷāka irunta tamiḻa riṭaiyē āriyar tamatu matattaiyum tattuva ñāṉattaiyum parappa muyaṉ ṟārkaḷ. vētamatam vaḻakkampōl uḷnāṭṭu vaḻakkaṅkaḷaiyum camayak koḷkaikaḷaiyum taḻuvik koṇṭatu. tamiḻariṉ vīrat teyvaṅkaḷum (teyvaṅkaḷākkappaṭṭa vīrar) piṟateyvaṅkaḷum pirāmaṇariṉ teyvaṅkaḷākkappaṭṭaṉa. iru mataṅkaḷukkum kalappu uṇṭāyiṟṟu. tamiḻar camayattiṉ mītu ayalavar celvākkiruntataip paṟṟi nām caṅka nūlkaḷil ciṟitu aṟikiṉṟōm.
uruttiraṉ vētaṅkaḷil civaṉeṉṟu kūṟappaṭavillai eṉṟum avar puyaṟ kaṭavuḷākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷāreṉṟum vēta ārāycci yāḷar kūṟukiṉṟaṉar. civa eṉṉum col vētattiṟ kāṇappaṭukiṟa teṉṟum atu kaṭavuḷaik kuṟiyāmal aruḷ, cāntam eṉpavaṟṟaik kuṟikkiṟateṉṟum ṭākṭar pōp kūṟiyuḷḷār. vētattil civaṉeṉṉum peyar kāṇappaṭavillai eṉa ṭākṭar isṭipiṉcaṉum kāṭṭiyuḷ ḷār. uruttiraṉai akkiṉi eṉak kāṭṭa muṭiyumāyiṉum akkiṉiyai yum uruttiraṉaiyum civaṉeṉak kāṭṭamuṭiyātu. uruttiraṉ oru mūrkka teyvam. atu maṟṟaiya vēta teyvaṅkaḷōṭu kūṟappaṭ ṭuḷḷatu. vētaṅkaḷukkup piṟpaṭṭa kālattil atu mummūrttikaḷuḷ oṉṟāṉa civaṉākak koḷḷappaṭṭatu. uruttiraṉaiyum mūrttikaḷuḷ oṉṟākak koṇṭa tamiḻar civaṉai mummūrttikaḷilum mēlāṉa kaṭavuḷākak koṇṭaṉar. itaṟku nūṟṟukkaṇakkāṉa cāṉṟukaḷait tamiḻ maṟaikaḷiliruntu kāṭṭalām. “mūvar kōṉāy niṉṟa mutalvaṉ” “muḻumutalē aimpulaṉukkum mūvarkkum eṉṟaṉakkum vaḻi mutalē” eṉṟu tiruvācakam kūṟakiṉṟatu.
tamiḻariṉ caivamatam vaṭanāṭṭuc celvākkukkuṭpaṭṭatu. appoḻutu tamiḻar caivattuḷ vētamatattukku iṭamaḷittārkaḷ. vētattil kāṇappaṭum uruttiraṉākiya puyal kaṭavuḷaip piritteṭuttu ataṟkuc civaṉukkuriya toḻilkaḷaik koṭuttuc civaṉākak koṇ ṭārkaḷ. āriyar civaṉai uruttiraṉ eṉak koṇṭaṉar. ivvāṟu iṇaikkappaṭṭa uruttira - civaṉ āriyar tamiḻar kaṭavuḷāka iruntār. tamiḻar teyvaṅkaḷ āriyar teyvaṅkaḷuḷ iṭam peṟṟatum civaṉ mummūrttikaḷuḷ oṉṟākkappaṭṭār. vētaṅkaḷ nāṉkākkappaṭṭa pōtu uruttiraṉ tēvarkaḷiṉ tēvaṉāka iruntār. upaniṭata kālattil vēta teyvaṅkaḷukkup patil uruttira civa vaḻipāṭu iruntatu.
avar maṅkaḷakaramāka iruntapōtu makēcuvaraṉ eṉṟum, mūrkka mākavum māmicam pucippavarākavum iruntapōtu uruttirareṉavum, ulakattaik kāppavarāka irukkum pōtu makātēvareṉavum aṟiyap paṭṭār. vaḻipaṭuvōrukku vēṇṭiya citti aḷittaliṉ civaṉ eṉṉum peyaruṇṭāṉa teṉṟu māpāratam kūṟukiṉṟatu. elumpu mālai aṇital mutal yōkiyākiya tōṟṟamaḷittal varaiyil collappaṭum civaṉiṉ vaṭivaṅkaḷ maṉitaṉiṉ aṟivu paṭippaṭiyē vaḷarcciyaṭainta kālaṅkaḷil avarkaḷ kaṭavuḷukkuk koṭuttu vaḻipaṭṭa vaṭivaṅkaḷaik kuṟikkiṉṟaṉa.*
vētaṅkaḷukkum ākamaṅkaḷukku muḷḷa vēṟupāṭukaḷ
#intukkaḷiṭaiyē iṉṟu naṭai muṟaiyilirukkum camayamum tattuva ñāṉamum ēṟakkuṟaiya muḻumaiyum ākamaṅkaḷai ātāramākak koṇṭavai. ivaṟṟukkum vētaṅkaḷukkum toṭarpirukkavillai. makāpāratattukkup piṉ vaitīkacamayam cīraṇamaṭaiyat toṭaṅki iṉṟu muṟṟāka iṟantu viṭṭatu. cirauta kiriyaikaḷiṉ perumpakuti maṟaintu viṭṭatu. akkiṉi ātāṉam pōṉṟa aṟpa kiriyaikaḷ mikac cilarāl ceyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. smārttak kiriyaikaḷum viraivil maṟaintu koṇṭu varukiṉṟaṉa. ek kuṭumpaṅkaḷaic cērntavarkaḷ mūṉṟu talai muṟaikaḷ tī ōmpat tavaṟukiṟārkaḷō ak kuṭumpattiṉar pirāmaṇat taṉmaiyai iḻantu viṭukiṉṟaṉar eṉṟu taruma cāttiram kūṟukiṉṟatu. iv vitiyiṉpaṭi mikaccila kuṭumpaṅkaḷaiyē pirāmaṇa vakuppaic cērntaṉavākak koḷḷalām. intiyā, camayattai mikap piṉpaṟṟum nāṭu. camayam ākama campantamāka irukkiṟatē aṉṟi vēta campantamāka irukka villai. vētaṅkaḷukkum ākamaṅkaḷukkumuḷḷa māṟupāṭu paḻaiya kālattil naṉku aṟiyappaṭṭiruntatu. ākamak koḷkaiyum vaitīkak koḷkaiyum etirāṉavai. cila nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷiṉ muṉ ivai oṉṟu cērkkappaṭṭaṉa. ākavē ik kālattavar iraṇṭu koḷkaikaḷukku muḷḷa vēṟupāṭukaḷai uṇarāmal irukkiṉṟaṉar. ākamaṅkaḷ vētaṅ kaḷiliruntu piṟantavai eṉṟum, avai vētaṅkaḷil kūṟappaṭṭavaṟṟai viḷakka ik kālattukkēṟpac ceyyap paṭṭavai eṉṟum koḷkaikaḷ nilavukiṉṟaṉa. vēta mantiraṅkaḷ tokukkappaṭṭapiṉ, avai evarā lum ceyyappaṭāmal tāmāka uḷḷaṉa eṉṉum nampikkai iruntatu. ākamaṅkaḷaik kaṭavuḷ kūṟiyatāka annūlkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. vēta caṅkitai kaḷiluḷḷa mantiraṅkaḷ vaitīkak kiriyaikaḷil ōta vēṇṭiyavai. ākamaṅkaḷ civavaḻipāṭu tirumāl vaḻipāṭukaḷil kaikkoḷḷa vēṇṭiya kiriyaikaḷaip paṟṟiyum, yōka cātaṉaikaḷaip paṟṟiyum, tattuva ñāṉaṅkaḷaip paṟṟiyum kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. vētaṅkaḷ mantira pākam pirāmaṇapākam allatu kaṉma kāṇṭam ñāṉa kāṇṭam eṉa iru pakutikaḷuṭaiyaṉa. ivaṟṟukku mīmāmcai vēṇṭappaṭum. ākamaṅkaḷukku viḷakka uraikaḷ māttiram vēṇṭappaṭum. vētaṅkaḷ cantam eṉṉum naṭaiyil eḻutappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. pāṣā eṉṉum naṭaiyiṉ kālam ki.pi.1000. vaitīkak kiriyaikaḷ tī campantappaṭṭavai. ovvoru kiriyai yiṉ pōtum tī mūṭṭi erikkappaṭukiṟatu. tī, cuvālaiyāka eriyum pōtu tēvarkaḷukku aḷikkum uṇavu cuvālaiyil iṭappaṭukiṉṟatu. ākamak kiriyaikaḷukkut tī vēṇṭappaṭuvatillai. uṇavu paṭaikkappaṭukiṟatu. paṭaikkappaṭṭa uṇaviṉ cattait teyvam āviyāka niṉṟu uṇkiṟatu; paṭaittavar uṇavai eṭuttuc cuṟṟattavarukkum naṇparukkum koṭuttu uṇkiṟār. vētakkiriyaikaḷil tēvarkaḷ aḻaikkappaṭukiṟārkaḷ. ovvoru tēvaṉukkum pirapañcattil ovvōr atikāramuṇṭu. ākamak kiriyaikaḷil oru muḻu mutaṟ kaṭavuḷē uṇṭu. avarukku paṭaippu mutaliya ellā atikāraṅkaḷumuṇṭu. vētakkiriyaikaḷil purōkitar puriyum ovvoru kiriyaikkum vevvēṟu mantiraṅkaḷuṇṭu. cōmak koṭi koṇṭu varum vaṇṭiyil erutukaḷaip pūṭṭutal, erutukaḷai ōṭṭuvataṟku kampu veṭṭutal, pali celuttum poruḷaik kaiyā leṭuttal, pāl kāyccutal, tayir kaṭaital ivai pōṉṟa periya allatu ciṟiya kiriyaikaḷ ovvoṉṟukkum pāṭal allatu vacaṉa vaṭiviluḷḷa mantiraṅkaḷ collappaṭṭaṉa. ākamakkiriyaikaḷil vētamantiraṅkaḷukku iṭamillai; aṅku miṅkum cila vētamantiraṅkaḷ payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. avai poruttamāṉavaiyalla. tū eṉat toṭaṅkum oru mantiram tūpaṅ kāṭṭumpōtu collappaṭukiṉṟatu. im mantiram vaṇṭiyiṉ nukattai uyarttuvataik kuṟikkiṉṟatu. ākamak kiriyaikaḷil pōṟṟi eṉa muṭiyum tutikaḷ pāṭappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. vētak kiriyaikaḷiṉ nōkkam tīyil palip poruḷkaḷai iṭuvatu. ākamak kiriyaikaḷ oru aracaṉukku allatu oru viruntiṉaṉukkuc ceyvatu pōṉṟa upacāraṅkaḷaic ceykiṉṟaṉa. vaitīkak kiriyaikaḷukkuk kaṭavuḷiṉ tiru uruvam vēṇṭappaṭavillai. tī ellāk kaṭavuḷaraiyum kuṟippatāka iruntatu. ākamak kiriyaiyil vaḻipaṭum teyvattaik kuṟikkum tiruvuruvam iṉṟiyamaiyātatu.
vētattiṉ cikaram vētāntam. vētāntam eṉpatu pirapañcat tōṟṟattukkuk kāraṇamākavuḷḷa piramattai aṟintu tāṉē piramamāy piṟappai oḻippatu. ākama muṟai pattimārkkam. cariyai kiriyai yōkam ñāṉam eṉṉum paṭi muṟaikaḷāl kaṭavuḷai aṭaiya vēṇṭumeṉa atu kūṟukiṉ ṟatu. ākamaṅkaḷil kūṟappaṭum tattuvañāṉam vētānta ñāṉattukkup puṟam pāṉatu. vētāntam kaṭavuḷoṉṟē uḷ poruḷ eṉkiṟatu. ākamaṅkaḷil yōka mārkkam ñāṉamārkkameṉṉum pakutikaḷiruppiṉum pattimārkkamē mutaṉmai uṭaiyatu.
vaitīkak kiriyaikaḷ makkaḷai varuṇaṅkaḷākap pirikkiṉṟatu. kaṭaici varuṇattavarukku vētāntak kalvi maṟukkappaṭṭuḷḷatu. varuṇaṅkaḷiliruntu varuṇāccirama tarumaṅkaḷ vaḷarntaṉa. tuṟavu pirāmaṇarukku māttiram uriyateṉṟum, caṉṉiyācam aṉuṭṭippatāl māttiram mutti aṭaiyalāmeṉṟum koḷḷappaṭṭaṉa. ākavē vaitīka neṟiyiloḻukum pirāmaṇarukku māttiram mutti kaikūṭum eṉak koḷḷappaṭṭatu. ākamaṅkaḷ ik koḷkaiyaip poruṭ paṭuttavillai; caṇṭāḷaṉāyiṉum kaṭavuḷuruvaṅkaḷai vaittup pūcik kalāmeṉṟaṉa. kaṇṇappar tirukkāḷattiyil kaṭavuḷukku iṟaicci vaittu naivēttiyam ceytār. tirunāḷaippōvār paṟaik kulatti ṉar. vaiṇava aṭiyāruḷ oruvar pāṇa vakuppiṉar. ākamaṅkaḷ nāl varuṇak koḷkaiyai aṉumatikkavillai. cūttirar vētaṅkaḷaik kēṭṭal kūṭāteṉa vātarāyaṇar kūṟiyirukkiṉṟār. ākamaṅkaḷai evarum payilalām. civatīṭcai peṟṟa paṟaik kulattiṉaṉum pirāmaṇa ṉukkut tīṭcai koṭuttu avaṉukkuk kuruvākalām. ākamak koḷkai yiṉariṭaiyē caṉṉiyācamum paraviyatu. vaiṇava caṉṉiyācikaḷ ēkānti kaḷeṉavum, caivacaṉṉiyācikaḷ civayōkikaḷ eṉavum aṟiyappaṭ ṭārkaḷ. caṉṉiyācattilum pattimārkkam ciṟantateṉavum, caṉṉi yācam pattimārkkattukku vāyppu aḷippatākavum koḷḷappaṭṭaṉa.
muṟkālattil vaitīkarukkum ākamak koḷkaiyiṉarukkumiṭai yil veṟuppu iruntu vantatu. ākamak koḷkaiyiṉar kaṭavuḷ peyarāl irattap paliyiṭuvataiyum, iṟaicci uṇpataiyum - ciṟappāka māṭṭiṟaicci uṇpatai - vilakkiṉārkaḷ. irattappaliyaiyum vēḷvi kaḷaiyum paṟṟiya etiroli māpāratattil kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu. ik kaṇṭaṉaṅkaḷiṉ palaṉāka vilaṅkukaḷaip paliyiṭuvataṟkup patil māvi ṉāl ceyyappaṭṭa vilaṅkiṉuruvaṅkaḷ paliyiṭappaṭṭaṉa. pākavata matattiṉariṉ ciṟanta nūl ākamak koḷkaikaḷait taḻuviya pakavatkītai. innūl vētānta ñāṉattaiyum cāṅkiya ñāṉattaiyum campantap paṭuttik kūṟukiṉṟatu. iññāṉaṅkaḷ oru uṇmaiyai viḷakkum iru vaḻikaḷākavum ākamak karuttuṭaiyaṉavākavum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. pakavatkītai vētattiṉ karuma kaṇṭattait taḷḷukiṉṟatu. annūluḷ ākamaṅkaḷukkuriya pala paripāṭaic coṟkaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
vaitīkar ākamak koḷkaiyiṉarai mika veṟuppuṭaṉ nōkki ṉar. vēta mantiraṅkaḷil āriyar tācukkaḷai ‘mirittiravāca’ eṉa ikaḻn tārkaḷ. av vikaḻcciyiṉ toṭarpē vaitīkar ākamikariṭam kāṭṭiya veṟuppākum. yamuṉāccāriyar kālam mutal vaitīkak koḷkaikaḷum ākamak koḷkaikaḷum iṇaikkappaṭṭapōtum iṉṟum av veṟuppai nām kāṇalām. vētāntikaḷ, caiva vaiṇava ālayaṅ kaḷil pūcai ceyyum pirāmaṇarai maṟṟaiya pirāmaṇarilum tāḻntava rākak karutuvar. aimpatu āṇṭukaḷiṉ muṉṉum atvaita vētāntikaḷ kōyilkaḷuḷ nuḻaiyātiruntamaiyai yām aṟivōm. vētattiṉ ciracu eṉappaṭum vētāntam ākamattaik kaṇṭikkiṟatu. vātarāyaṇar pācupatattaiyum pāñcarāttirattaiyum kaṇṭittirukkiṟār.
āriyariṉ vētaṅkaḷ tōṉṟumuṉ tācukkaḷiṉ matam vaṭa nāṭṭilum teṉṉāṭṭilumiruntatu. cirauta kiriyaikaḷ pirāmaṇar, aracar, purōkitarukku atika takkaṇai koṭukkakkūṭiya celvam paṭaitta vaṇikarukku māttiram uriyaṉavāyiruntaṉa; potu makkaḷ tamatu contak kiriyaikaḷai uṭaiyavarkaḷāka iruntārkaḷ. ak kiriyaikaḷ tācukkaḷiṉ kiriyaikaḷāka iruntaṉa. avai iṉṟu cāntāl makkaḷiṭaiyē kāṇappaṭuvaṉapōl teyvattukku uṇavu paṭaittal āṭutal pāṭutal vakaikaḷiliruntaṉa. vālmīkar cukkirīpaṉiṉ muṭi cūṭṭaip paṟṟik kūṟiyiruppatu itaṉai viḷakkukiṉṟatu.
makāpāratattiṉ piṉ āriyariṉ tī vaḻipāṭu vīḻcci aṭaintatu. pirāmaṇariṉ pārvai naṭaimuṟaiyilirunta kiriyaikaḷil ceṉṟatu. avarkaḷ pirāmaṇaṅkaḷaip patti vaḻiyil tiruppiṉārkaḷ; tirumūrtti eṉṉum koḷkaiyait tōṟṟuvittārkaḷ; cāṅkiyattil kūṟappaṭum mukkuṇattait tirumūrttikaḷōṭu toṭarpu paṭuttiṉārkaḷ. ciṟitu ciṟitāka 108 vaiṇava ākamaṅkaḷaiyum 28 caiva ākamaṅkaḷaiyum ceytapiṉ 77 cakti ākamaṅkaḷaiyum ceytārkaḷ. pāṇiṉi muṉivar civa vaḻipāṭṭaiyum kiruṭṭiṇa vaḻipāṭṭaiyum kuṟippiṭṭirukkiṉṟār. 
vētāntamum ākamamum mika metuvāka iṇaintu koṇṭu vantaṉa. purāṇaṅkaḷil avai oṉṟiṉ pakkattil oṉṟāka varukiṉṟaṉa; oṉṟāka iṇaiyavillai; caṅkarāccāriyar kālattilum avai iṇaiyāmalē iruntaṉa. avar vātarāyaṇaraip piṉpaṟṟi pācupata pāñcarāttira mataṅkaḷaip puṟac camayaṅkaḷeṉak koḷkiṉṟār. caṅkarar ceyta pirapañca irutayam eṉpatu ākamattait taḻuviya nūl. avar caṭmata tāpaṉācāriyar eṉappaṭṭār. avar viṣṇu, civaṉ, catti, kaṇapati, cuppiramaṇiyar, cūriyaṉ eṉṉum vaḻipāṭukaḷait tām toṭaṅkiya maṭaṅkaḷil ēṟpaṭuttiṉār.
viciṭṭāttuvaitam eṉṉum vaiṇava vētāntattai toṭaṅkiya yamuṉāccāriyar vaiṇava ākamaṅkaḷai vētaṅkaḷaip pōlap piramāṇamākka vēṇṭumeṉak kaṭṭaḷaiyiṭṭu iraṇṭaiyum oṉṟu cērttār.
camakkiruta ātikkam
teṟkē vaitīka matam paravat toṭaṅkiṟṟu. vaitīka nūlkaḷ camak kirutattil eḻutappaṭṭiruntaṉa. teṉṉāṭṭavar camakkirutam payiṉṟaṉar. pāṇiṉi muṉivarukkup piṉ ciṟanta vaṭamoḻi nūlkaḷaic ceytavarkaḷ perumpālum teṉṉāṭṭiṉarākavē kāṇappaṭukiṉ ṟaṉar.37 apastampar, pōtāyaṉar, kauṭaliyar, kāttiyāyaṉar, kumārilar, vaṟcayāyaṉar, cāyaṇar, caṅkarar, irāmāṉucar, mātavar, vittiyāraṇiyar mutaliya teṉṉāṭṭiṉar ceyta vaṭamoḻi nūlkaḷ pukaḻpeṟṟu viḷaṅkukiṉṟaṉa. purāṇaṅkaḷ palavaṟṟaic ceytavarkaḷum teṉṉāṭṭiṉarē.
pallavarum avarukkup piṉ vanta vaṭanāṭṭu araca paramparai yiṉarum camakkirutattukkup pērātaravu aḷittārkaḷ. pirāmaṇar vāḻum iṭaṅkaḷ tōṟum kaṭikaikaḷ allatu piramapurikaḷ eṉṉum camakkirutak kalācālaikaḷ niṟuviṉārkaḷ. avaikaḷil kalvi payilum māṇavarukkum kalvi payiṟṟum āciriyarukkum uṇavu uṭai mutaliyaṉa vaḻaṅkiṉar. kalā cālaikaḷil vētaṅkaḷ, vētāṅkaṅkaḷ, taruma cāttiraṅkaḷ, arttacāttiram mutaliya kalvikaḷ kaṟpikkappaṭṭaṉa. camakkirutak kalvi pirāmaṇariṉ ēkapōka urimaiyāka iruntatu. kaṭikaikaḷil kaṟṟut tēṟiya pirāmaṇar irācakurukkaḷ eṉṉum peyaruṭaṉ nāṭu muḻumaiyilum ceṉṟu vaitīka matattai makkaḷukkup pōtittārkaḷ. irāca kurukkaḷē araca kuṭumpattiṉarukkuk kalvi kaṟpittārkaḷ.*
pirāmaṇariṉ cēvai vēṇṭappaṭṭa iṭaṅkaḷil avarkaḷ ceṉṟu vāḻvataṟkut tūṇṭutalāka nilamum vīṭum māṉiyamāka vaḻaṅkappaṭṭaṉa. ivvāṟu vaitīkattukkum camakkirutattukkum cel vākku vaḷarntu koṇṭu ceṉṟatu. camaya campantamāṉavai ellām camakkirutattil iruttal vēṇṭum. camakkirutattukku atikārikaḷ pirāmaṇar eṉpavai pōṉṟa karuttukkaḷ nāḷ vītam palamaṭaintu koṇṭu vantaṉa. ākavē, tamiḻil camayacampantamāṉa tala purāṇaṅ kaḷō, vēṟu purāṇaṅkaḷō eḻutuvōrum tām eḻutuvaṉa ētō vaṭamoḻi nūliluḷḷaṉa eṉak kūṟum vaḻakku ēṟpaṭṭatu. camakkirutat tiliruntu tāṉ ulakiluḷḷa ellā moḻikaḷum tōṉṟiṉa. am moḻiyilillāta aṟivu vēṟetilumillai eṉavum kūṟappaṭṭaṉa.38 pallavarum avarukkup piṟpaṭṭa aracarum tamiḻk kalviyiṉ poruṭṭu ātaravaḷittataip paṟṟiya kalveṭṭuc cācaṉam oṉṟēṉum kāṇap paṭavillai. kalvi eṉpatu camakkirutak kalvi oṉṟumē eṉak karutap paṭṭatu. camakkirutak kalā cālaikaḷil ākamaṅkaḷ payilappaṭṭatākak kūṟappaṭavillai. vaitīkar ākamaṅkaḷaiyum, vētaṅkaḷaiyum vētat tōṭu campantappaṭṭa nūlkaḷaiyum pōl ciṟantaṉavāka matikka villai. kōyil pūcai ceyyum pirāmaṇar ēṉaiya pirāmaṇarilum tāḻntavarkaḷāka nōkkappaṭṭaṉar.*
caiva maṭaṅkaḷ
40tamiḻ nāṭṭil vaitikam campantam peṟāta caiva maṭaṅka ḷiruntaṉa. avaṟṟil kuravariṭattil mahṇahkkar pāṭaṅkēṭṭal camaya cātaṉaikaḷ ceytal pōṉṟa nikaḻccikaḷ naṭaipeṟṟaṉa. kōyilkaḷ pirāmaṇariṉ kaikku māṟiyapōtu kōyilkaḷukkup pakkattil maṭaṅka ḷamaikkappaṭṭaṉa. kōyilai mēṟpārkkum pirāmaṇar maṭattiliruntu kōyil kiriyaikaḷ oḻuṅkāka naṭaipeṟuvataik kavaṉittu vantār. ivvāṟiruntu varumpōtu pirāmaṇarallātavar tuṟavikaḷāvataṟkum (caṉṉiyācam koḷvataṟkum) avarkaḷ maṭaṅkaḷukkut talaivarāva taṟkum taṭai eḻuntatu. ākavē, pirāmaṇarallāta tuṟavikaḷ kukaikaḷai nāṭic ceṉṟaṉar. pirāmaṇarallātāriṉ kukai maṭaṅkaḷ atikappaṭṭu avaṟṟiṉ celvākkum atikappaṭṭa pōtu ammaṭaṅkaḷai aḻittut taraimaṭṭappaṭuttumpaṭi pirāmaṇar tammai ātarippōrait tūṇṭiṉar.41 ‘kukai iṭi kalakam’ eṉṉum peyaril periya kalakaṅkaḷ nērntaṉa. kukai iṭi kalakaṅkaḷaippaṟṟic cācaṉaṅkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. pirāmaṇarallātāriṉ maṭaṅkaḷ aḻittut taraimaṭṭamākkappaṭṭaṉa. mūṉṟāṅ kulōttuṅka cōḻaṉ kālattil pirāmaṇa matattavar pirāmaṇa rallātāriṉ maṭamoṉṟukkuk koṭutta cottu piṭuṅkappaṭṭataip paṟṟi oru cācaṉaṅ kūṟukiṉṟatu. vicaya nakara aracar kālattil pirāmaṇa rallātār tuṟavu pūṇuvataṟku etirāṉa vaḻakkoṉṟu nērntatu, appoḻutu vicaya nakara aracariṉ kīḻ atikāriyāka irunta ciṉṉa cevvappa nāyakkar av vaḻakkukkut tīrppaḷikkum paṭi civākkira yōkikaḷaik kēṭṭukkoṇṭār. avar tamatu tīrppai ‘caivacamaya caṉṉiyāca pattati’ eṉṉum nūl vaṭivil kūṟiṉār. atu pirāmaṇa rallātārukku aṉu kūlamāṉatu.
kōyilkaḷ pirāmaṇar kaippaṭṭapiṉ iṉṉoru koḷkai yum talai eṭuttatu. camaya aṟivai vētaṅkaḷiliruntu nērē aṟivatallatu uḷ nāṭṭu moḻikaḷil eḻutappaṭṭa nūlkaḷaik kaṟṟu avai mūlam aṟivatāl payaṉillai eṉṉum koḷkai eḻuntatu. vaṭamoḻik kalvi pirāmaṇarukku māttiram ēka pōka urimaiyāka iruntatu. 42ik koḷkaiyait tamiḻaṟiñar etirttaṉar. vaiṇavaril teṉkalaiyiṉar itaṟkut talaicāykkavillai. ak kālattil tamiḻ maṟumalarcci peṟṟatu. uraiyāciriyarkaḷ tōṉṟip paḻantamiḻ nūlkaḷukku uraikaḷ ceytaṉar. cantāṉa kuravarkaḷ camaya nūlkaḷait tamiḻil ceytaṉar. cittar nūlkaḷum ik kālattai aṭuttu eḻuntaṉa. cittar nūlkaḷ pirāmaṇa ātikkattai etirkka eḻuntavai. caiva maṭaṅkaḷ pala tōṉṟiṉa. caiva maṭaṅkaḷiṉ talaivar pirāmaṇarallātārākavē iruntu varuvar.
pirāmaṇar kōyilkaḷukkut talaivarāṉa pōtu kōyil peyarkaḷ vaṭamoḻippaṭuttappaṭṭaṉa. tirumaṟaikkāṭu vētāraṇiya meṉavum, mutukuṉṟu viruttācalam eṉavum, kuṭamūkku kumpakōṇameṉa vum, veṇkāṭu cuvētavaṉa meṉavum, tiruppukalūr caraṇayapuram eṉavum, tiruvaiyāṟu pañcanatam eṉavum paṭṭaṉa.
kōyilkaḷ toṭarpākac cācaṉaṅkaḷil kāṇappaṭum cila peyarkaḷ; taḷiccēri - kōyilaic cūḻnta kuṭiyiruppu; kaṟṟaḷi-kaṟ kōyil; naṭṭuvaṉ, aṇṇāvi naṭaṉaṅ kaṟṟuk koṭuppōr; āṭuvār; kaṉapāṭi; mukavīṇaikkārar; uṭukkai vācikkiṟavar; vīṇai vācip pōr; āriyam pāṭuvār; tamiḻ pāṭuvār; koṭṭi mattaḷak kārar; muttirai caṅku ūtuvōr; pakka vāttiyakārar; kaṭṭiyaṅkūṟu vōr; mēḷam vācippavar; kāntaruvar; viḷakkuppōṭukiṟavar; nīr teḷippavar; eṭupiṭi cāmāṉ tūkkukiṟavarkaḷ; vaṇṇāṉ; nāvitaṉ; kollaṉ; taiyāṉ; pāṭukiṟavaṉ; cōtiṭaṉ; kaṉṉāṉ; ōccaṉ; taṭṭāṉ; pāṇaṉ; kaṇakkaṉ.
vaitīkattukku etirppu
caṅka kālattiṟuti mutal cila nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷ pautta camaṇa mataṅkaḷ teṟkil celvākkup peṟṟiruntaṉa. ki.pi. 5 ām nūṟṟāṇṭil vaccira nanti eṉṉum camaṇa muṉivariṉ talaimaiyil maturaiyil ōr tamiḻc caṅkam iruntatu. ic caṅkattilēyē patiṉeṇkīḻkkaṇakkaic cērnta nūlkaḷ pala ceyyappaṭṭaṉa veṉṟu karutappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. tiruñāṉa campantar kālattuk kūṉ pāṇṭiyaṉum, appar cuvāmikaḷ kālattil pallavamāṟavarmaṉum camaṇa matattait taḻuviyiruntārkaḷ. māṇikkavācaka cuvāmikaḷ pauttarōṭu vātuceytu veṉṟatākap purāṇam kūṟukiṉṟatu. pautta camaṇa mataṅkaḷ celvākkup peṟ ṟirunta kālattu caivarum vaiṇava camayattavarum oruṅku cērntu pautta camaṇa mataṅkaḷai etirttārkaḷ. vaitīka camayattiṉarum ivar kaḷuṭaṉ cērntaṉar. appoḻutu vaitīkar ākamak koḷkaikaḷ pala vaṟṟait taḻuviṉar; tamatu vētaṅkaḷ caiva vaiṇava camayaṅkaḷum mutal nūlkaḷeṉṟaṉar. ikkoḷkai peyaraḷaviliruntataṉṟic ceyalaḷavi lirukkavillai. vētaṅkaḷum ākamaṅkaḷum māṟupaṭṭaṉaveṉṉum koḷkai iruntu vantatu. vētaṅkaḷum ākamaṅkaḷum māṟupaṭṭavai yalla eṉap piṟkālattavar kūṟivantaṉar. piṟkālattavarkaḷ vētam eṉak kūṟiyavaṟṟai nōkkiṉāl avai vētaṅkaḷaik kuṟiyātu piṟkāla upa niṭataṅkaḷaik kuṟippaṉavākat terikiṉṟaṉa. itaṉai civañāṉa muṉivariṉ civañāṉa pōtamā pāṭiyattil āṅkāṅku kūṟappaṭuvaṉa vaṟṟaik koṇṭu naṉku uyttaṟiyalām.
kōyilkaḷil vaitīkar talaimai eytutalaiyum aṅku āriyam pāṭappaṭuvataiyum aṟiñar etirttuk kiḷarcci ceytārkaḷ. “āriyaṉ kaṇṭāy tamiḻaṉ kaṇṭāy” “centamiḻōṭu āriyaṉaic cīriyāṉai” “āriyan tamiḻō ṭicaiyāṉavaṉ” eṉat tirunāvukkaracu nāyaṉār tamatu tiruppāṭalkaḷil kūṟi irucārāraiyum cantu ceytār. “āriyap puttakap pēy koṇṭu pulampiṟṟu” eṉa nakkīrar tām pāṭiya kōpap piracāttil vaṭamoḻip pāṭalkaḷaip pāṭutalai veṟuttuk kūṟukiṉṟār.
tolkāppiyap poruḷatikāra uraiyil (poruḷ 490)
āriya naṉṟu tamiḻ tīteṉa vuraitta
kāriyattāṟ kālakkōṭ paṭṭāṉaic - cīriya
antaṇ potiyil akattiyaṉā rāṇaiyāl
centamiḻē tīrkka cuvākā.
eṉṉum veṇpā oṉṟu mēṟkōḷākak kāṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. ak kālattil āriyam tamiḻ eṉpavaṟṟukku iṭaiyilirunta māṟupāṭu kaḷai iv veṇpā uṇarttukiṉṟatu.
vaitīkamum camakkirutamum oṉṟai viṭṭu oṉṟaip pirikka muṭiyātaṉavākavuḷḷaṉa. vaṭamoḻikkup pātakamākak kūṟuvateṉpatu vaitīkattukku etirākak kūṟappaṭuvatu eṉṉum koḷkai iruntu vantatu. tamiḻaṟiñar tamiḻmoḻi vaṭamoḻikku evvakaiyilum tāḻnta taṉṟu, cilavakaikaḷil ataṉilum uyarntatu eṉak kūṟi vantaṉar.
toṇṭar nātaṉait tūtiṭai viṭuttatu mutalai

paccaip pacuṅ koṇṭalē. (mī. piḷḷait tamiḻ)
ivvāṟu kūṟiya ceyyuḷkaḷukku viṭainiṟuppatu pōlac cāmi nāta tēcikar avarkaḷ tamatu ilakkaṇak kottil “oṉṟēyāyiṉum taṉit tamiḻ uṇṭō” eṉavum “ainteḻuttāloru pāṭaiyum uṇṭeṉa aṟaiyavum nāṇuvar aṟivuṭaiyōrē” eṉavum kūṟiṉar. pirayōka vivēkamuṭaiyār vaṭamoḻikkun tamiḻukkum ilakkaṇa moṉṟeṉṟaṉar. civañāṉa muṉivar irumoḻikaḷiṉ ilakkaṇaṅ kaḷum vēṟu eṉṟaṉar. camīpa kālattil cilar tolkāppiyac cūttiraṅ kaḷai āṅkilattil moḻi peyarttut tamiḻ ilakkaṇam vaṭamoḻi ilakkaṇattait taḻuvic ceyyappaṭṭateṉak kāṭṭiṉar. vaṭamoḻi ilakkaṇam toṭakkattil tamiḻ ilakkaṇattaip piṉpaṟṟic ceyyap paṭṭataṉāl iru moḻi ilakkaṇaṅkaḷukkum cila orumaippāṭukaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉaveṉpatē uṇmai. vaṭamoḻikku ilakkaṇam vakukkat tuṇai purintavarkaḷ tamiḻmakkaḷē eṉpatu aṟiñar karuttākum.
“irumoḻiyum nikar eṉṟu karutiya ip periyār kālattukkup piṉ vaṭamoḻi teyva moḻi eṉṉum karuttu mella mellat tamiḻ nāṭṭil nuḻaivatāyiṟṟu. vaṭamoḻiyil amainta itikācaṅkaḷ tamiḻil moḻi peyarkkappaṭṭaṉa. vāṉmīkar vaṭamoḻiyil eḻutiya āti kāviyattait tamiḻil amaikkap pōnta kalviyiṟ periyar kampar (ki.pi.12ām nūṟṟāṇṭu) “tēva pāṭaiyiṉ ikkatai ceytavar” eṉa mutaṉūl ceyta pulavaraip pukaḻnturaittār; vāṅkarum pātam nāṉkum vakutta vāṉmīki eṉpāṉ - tīṅkavi cevikaḷārat tēvarum virumpac ceytāṉ” eṉṟu vaṭamoḻip pulavarai vāyāra vāḻttiṉār. vaṭa moḻi vāṉavar moḻi ātalāl viḻumiyamoḻiyeṉṟum tamiḻ moḻiyātalāl tāḻnta moḻiyeṉṟum karutum vaḻakkam mella mella eḻuntatu. vaṭamoḻiyilamainta purāṇa nūlkaḷait tamiḻil moḻi peyarkkappukuntār cilar; mutal nūlkaḷākat tamiḻileḻunta nūlkaḷukkum vaṭamoḻiyil nūl uṇṭeṉṟu kūṟa muṟpaṭṭār cilar; naṉṉūl ceyta pavaṇantiyārum, ciṉṉūl ceyta kuṇavīraṉārum vīracōḻiyamiyaṟṟiya puttamittaṉārum vaṭamoḻi ilakkaṇap pōkkait taḻuvi eḻutuvarāyiṉar. tamiḻnāṭṭilamainta iṭappeyar ūrp peyarkaḷaiyum vaṭamoḻiyil peyarttu vaḻaṅkattalaip paṭṭār palar. itaik kuṟittut tamiḻ nāṭṭuc cācaṉaṅkaḷai ārāyntu parṇal eṉpār kūṟum moḻi īṇṭu karutat takkaṉavām. cila tamiḻp peyarkaḷ tavaṟāka vaṭamoḻiyil peyarkkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa eṉṟum, maṟṟum cila tamiḻp peyarkaḷ araikuṟaiyāka vaṭa moḻiyil peyark kappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa eṉṟum iṉṉum cila tamiḻp peyarkaḷ iyaṟporu ḷiḻantu vaṭanūl kataikaḷai ēṟṟut tirittu vaḻaṅkukiṉṟaṉaveṉṟum ṭākṭar parṇal kūṟukiṉṟār. paḻantamiḻ nāṭṭil kuṭamūkku eṉṟu vaḻaṅkiya ūr kumpakōṇamāyiṟṟu. maṟaikkāṭu vētāraṇiyamāyiṟṟu. veṇkāṭu cuvētāraṇyamāyiṟṟu. aiyāṟu pañcanatamākavum, aṇṇā malai aruṇācalamākavum amaintaṉa ... ivvāṟāṉa vaṭamoḻi uyarntateṉṟum tamiḻ tāḻntateṉṟum kaṟṟārum kallātārum karutiṉamaiyāl tamiḻeṉṉum collē vaṭamoḻic citaiveṉṉum koḷkai vaṭanāṭṭil paravuvatāyiṟṟu. tirāviṭam eṉṉum collē tirāviṭam, tirāmiḷam, tiramiḷam, tamiḷam, tamiḻ eṉṟu āyiṟṟeṉṟu ilakkaṇa nūlōr eṭutturaippārāyiṉar. iṉṟum tamiḻ ilakkaṇam vaṭamoḻi ilakkaṇattait taḻuvi eḻuntateṉṟu pirayōka vivēkam kūṟuvatāyiṟṟu. tamiḻ taṉimoḻi yaṉṟeṉṟum ilakkaṇak kotturaitta tēcikar eḻutuvarāyiṉar.
“ainteḻuttāl oru pāṭaiyum uṇṭeṉa 
aṟaiyavum nāṇuvar aṟivuṭaiyōrē
vaṭamoḻi tamiḻmoḻi yeṉumirumoḻiyiṉum
ilakkaṇam oṉṟē eṉṟē eṇṇuka (ilakkaṇak kottu)
eṉṟu tamiḻ moḻiyait taṉi moḻiyeṉṟu karutum koḷkaiyait tēcikar iḻitturaittār.”*
iṉṟaiya intu matam
vētamatam maṟaintu pōyiṟṟu. iṉṟu yākaṅkaḷ naṭattappaṭuva tillai. ākama campantamāṉa civa vaḻipāṭu tirumāl vaḻipāṭukaḷōṭu vaitīkak koḷkaikaḷ kalanta matamē iṉṟaiya intu camayamāka iruntu varukiṉṟatu.45
vaṭamoḻiyaic camaya moḻiyākak koṇṭavarkaḷum vētaṅka ḷai ātāramākak koḷpavarumākiya vaitīkarē caiva vaiṇava kōyil kaḷukkup pūcakarākavum, purōkitarkaḷākavum iṭam peṟṟamaiyāl teṉṉāṭṭil pala mayakkaṅkaḷ iruntu varukiṉṟaṉa. purōkita vakuppiṉar camaya varalāṟukaḷ, intiya varalāṟukaḷ eḻutumpōtu vaitīkariṉ perumaikaḷai atikappaṭuttiyum tamiḻariṉ perumaikaḷai aṟpappaṭuttiyum kūṟuvar.46 ākavē camayacampantamāṉavum, moḻi campantamāṉavum uṇmai varalāṟukaḷai aṟivataṟku mēlnāṭṭavar allatu purōkita vakuppiṉarallātār eḻutiya nūlkaḷaiyē nām nāṭa vēṇṭiyirukkiṟatu. uṇmai varalāṟukaḷai veḷiyiṭutal oru vakuppiṉarukku etirāka nūleḻututal eṉpatu pōlavum tōṉṟu kiṟatu. kōyilkaḷilum araciyal tuṟaikaḷilum atikārattilumirukkum oruvakuppiṉariṉ veṟuppai īṭṭik koḷḷa virumpāta cilarum uṇmai varalāṟukaḷai veḷiyiṭap piṉṉiṟpar. mēlnāṭṭavariṉ ārāyccikaḷai namputal kūṭātu, āriyar veḷiyiliruntu varavillai, vaṭamoḻiyum tamiḻum intiya nāṭṭil eṉṟumuḷḷaṉa eṉavum cilar kūṟivarukiṉṟaṉar. ik kūṟṟukkaḷ ārāycciyiṉ muṉ valipeṟṟu niṟka# muṭiyavillai.
NOTES
(Quotations from eminent authors in support of the statements found in this book)
1. The original home of the Indo-Germanic language was the long stretch of grass-land extending from the north of the Carpathians and the Lower Danube to the foot-hills below Altai and Tianshan in Central Asia skirting the shores of the Black Sea and Caspian, and extending south to Cacasus and the steep north edge of Persia. This was the area of characterization of a race of tall, fair-skinned, blue-eyed, narrow-headed giants to whom the name Proto-Nodics has been given. The grass-land made them develop a pastoral life, modified by some hunting on the one hand and some very primitive agriculture on the other. Their one noteable contribution to the growth of world civilization was that the domesticated horse.
About 2,500 B.C., a great wave of descciation seems to have passed over Asia which converted steppes of the north as well as the Semites of Arabian grass-land in search of pastures new. This great displacement of tribes included the “Ganaanite” invasion of Syria referred to in the Genesis as the Semite migration into Mesapotamia leading to the establishment of a powerful Babylonian monarchy. From the northern steppes, the Nordics went out in many branches. - The age of the mantras pp. 103, 105. - P.T.S. Iyengar.
2. Pargiter adduces considerable evidence to show that the true Brahman families were of pre-Rigvedic origin, and the Aryan kings of Madhya Desa were their own priests in the earliest times had no Brahmans. - Castes in India its nature, function and origins. – J.H.Hutton.
3. The language of the Rig-Veda is as yet purely Aryan or Indo-European in its form, structure and spirit but its phonetics is already affected by the Dravidian and it has already begun to borrow words from Dravidian and Kol. Among the words of probable Dravidian origin in the Rig-Veda the following may be noted.
anu – particle; arani – rubbing wood for fire; kapi – monkey; karmara – smith; kala – time; kunda – hole; gana – band; nana – several; nila – blue; pushpa – flower; puja – worship; pala – fruit; majura – peafowl; ratri – night; rupa – form. - The origin and development of Bengali p.42. - S.K. Chaterji.

5. The whole of the Veda, Sruti (heard or revealed was compiled during the long period from about 1,500 B.C. to 500 B.C.) and includes the following extensive literature: (1) The four Vedas proper Rig, Yajur, Sama, Atharva which are hymns, prayers, and sacred formulas offered by priests to the gods on behalf of rich lay-sacrificers, charms for witchcraft, medicine and other homely practices, manipulated by magicians and medicine men in main for the plainer people. - Ibid p. 10.
5. The authors of the hymns, called Rishis, composed them for the purpose of invoking the help of gods in events that immediately interested them to secure success in impending battles (R.V. XIX – 4), to avert drought (R.V.68), to help to raise crops (A.V.VI. 142) to enable them to live a “hundred autums” till their sons became fathers in their turn (R.V.I. 89. 9), to satisfy all possible wants (A.V.XV.9), and to escape all kinds of dangers and difficulties (A.V.XIX.7) - The age of the mantras p.4. - P.T.S. Iyengar.
6. The shock of intercourse with the alien culture of the Dravidians awaked in the conquerors the desire to preserve their literary inheritance, and although during the time it took to give it a permanent shape it became strongly mixed with aboriginal Dravidian belief, this was the way that the Vedas, the oldest books of the Hindus came to be composed. - Hindu view of art p. 10. – Maluk Raj Anand.
7. Of the writings called Anukramani in which the metre, the deity and author of each song are given in their proper order. - The history of Indian literature p. 61. - A Weber.
8. Of the gods invoked in the Vedas the following are chief. Dyaus or Dyaus Pitar, sky or father of sky; Surya and Savitir, Vishnu, the sun-god; ushas the dawn; Agni the fire; Pritivi the earth; Soma, the intoxicating vegetable juice used in ritual; Indra the god of lightning and thunder; Varuna the universal embracer and encompasser; Adityas, boundless ones; Asvins, horse men; Vayu, the wind; Rudra, the fierce god of distruction and waste etc. This list was considerably enlarged as the Aryans continued to assimilate the gods and goddnesses of the non-Aryan inhabitants of India. - Hindu view in art. – p.11.
9. Civa is a god unknown to the Vedas; his name is a word of not frequent occurrence in the hymns, indeed but means simply prosperous, not even in the Atharvan it is the epithet of a particular divinity or distinguished by the usage, from any other adjectives. The precise relation between Civa and Rudra is not yet satisfactorily traced out. - Oriental linguistic studies. P.30. - William Dwlight Whitney.
10. Practically no traces of it (rebirth) are to be found in the Vedas or in the poems of Homer. The Vedic hero like the Homeric hero goes to dwell in the Elysium of Yama, the proto-man, and returns no more to earth. - India and the Western World. - H.G. Rawlinson.
10. The doctrine of transmigration is entirely absent from the Vedas and early Brahmanas. It seems probable that the Indian Aryans borrowed the idea from the aboriginals. - Cambridge History of India, p. 108. - Prof. Macdonald.
11. The simple ritual of the Rig-Veda had now under the influence of Dravidian methods of worship, became an elaborate system of mechanical rites and ceremonies in Brahmanas. - Hindu view in art. p. 18.
